description: Defines the LoadTimingInfo structure and nested ConnectTiming class for capturing detailed network request timing metrics, including connection, SSL, proxy resolution, and request/response events, used for performance analysis and resource timing.

classes.name: net::LoadTimingInfo
classes.description: Structure holding detailed timing information for network requests, including connection, SSL, proxy resolution, and request/response timings.

classes.name: net::LoadTimingInfo::ConnectTiming
classes.description: Nested class within LoadTimingInfo that captures timing details related to establishing a network connection, including DNS lookup, connection, and SSL handshake times.
